1.consolidated_definition: mús. Se dice del estilo de música electrónica bailable, creado en los primeros años de la década de los ochenta en Detroit, Michigan. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. También interpreta la guitarra y fantasea mezclar Arias conocidas en una base musical techno, trance o drum and base, en lo que ella describe como “una forma para que la gente conozca ese género musical”
1.en_consolidated_definition: Musical term. Refers to the style of electronic dance music created in the early years of the 1980s in Detroit, Michigan. Raw Anglicism, infrequently used. Also refers to a musician who plays the guitar and fantasizes about combining well-known arias with techno, trance, or drum and bass music, describing this as "a way for people to become familiar with that musical genre".
